routes.label: SOLVIT informal problem-solving route
powers: Informal problem-solving within the SOLVIT framework.
limits: SOLVIT is an informal, non-judicial route and does not itself create a binding individual remedy.
The bundled Recommendation is non-binding soft law; route suitability remains case-specific.
authority_competence: Informal problem-solving for qualifying cross-border EU-law problems within the SOLVIT framework.

routes.label: European Commission complaint about a possible Member-State breach of EU law
powers: EU-law enforcement assessment at Commission level.
limits: This route is not an individual administrative appeal and does not guarantee individual redress.
The Commission page records national redress as a first-line consideration; route selection remains case-specific.
authority_competence: Complaints concerning possible breaches of EU law by Member States.

routes.label: European Ombudsman complaint route
powers: Complaint handling within the European Ombudsman mandate.
limits: This route concerns EU institutions and bodies, not Member-State authorities.
Admissibility and remedy consequences remain subject to the Ombudsman framework and case-specific review.
authority_competence: Complaints concerning maladministration by EU institutions and bodies.
